prompt.project_info: Create photorealistic lifestyle photography of an adult woman celebrating beside an off-road SUV on a tropical beach.
prompt.main_subject: An adult blonde woman with windblown hair, an open joyful smile, and relaxed athletic vacation presence. She wears an orange patterned bikini and sits on the open door frame of a dark off-road SUV with both arms raised in celebration.
prompt.composition_elements: Dynamic foreground subject on the SUV door, dark vehicle body visible, tall palms, turquoise ocean waves, sandy grass dunes, and bright blue sky with scattered clouds behind her. Use a 35mm DSLR perspective with vivid natural colors and sharp focus.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright natural daylight, carefree beach-adventure energy, crisp tropical color, realistic vehicle, hair, skin, sand, and wave texture.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm lens, f/2.8, photorealistic high-resolution professional lifestyle photography, dynamic vertical composition, subject sharp and background legible.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A joyful tropical beach scene with an adult blonde woman sitting on the open door frame of a dark off-road SUV parked near the shoreline. She wears an orange patterned bikini, raises both arms in celebration, and smiles openly as her windblown hair moves in the breeze. Tall palm trees, turquoise ocean waves, sandy grass dunes, and bright blue sky with scattered clouds fill the background. Bright natural daylight, photorealistic lifestyle photography, 35mm DSLR, f/2.8, dynamic foreground composition, sharp focus, vivid natural colors, carefree summer vacation and beach-adventure mood.

assets.usage: Preserve approved adult face, windblown hair, smile, orange bikini, and raised-arm pose; replaceable with another approved adult.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the matching preview for adult identity, vehicle, pose, wardrobe, and tropical environment. Preserve face, hair, smile, door interaction, and 35mm perspective. Person, vehicle, and location may be replaced only with equivalent approved references; no typography or logos are required.
